title: Australian experience. A practical approach.
bio_1: Kumar & Associates was founded by Kapil Kumar, a CPA Australia member and Australian graduate with onshore experience across public practice and industry.
bio_2: His professional background includes NSW Trustee & Guardian, Wexted Advisors (insolvency) and BDO (audit). That experience informs how the firm approaches deadlines, workpaper quality, practitioner oversight and communication.
